name: code-sample-01
title: Code Sample 01 - A Titled Snippet With A Sentence And A Control
description: A titled code sample: a name, a sentence about what the code shows, the code in the code block Component with its header and gutter, and a slot for the caller's own controls. The title is required, because a sample with no name is a snippet and a snippet is a code block the reader cannot refer to. A section of its own by default, or a band inside a section the caller already owns.
